dedupe_keys.name: virtualfcs hybrid fuel cell system model

description: VirtualFCS is the European Virtual-FCS project's Modelica library for hybrid fuel-cell system dynamics. It represents a fuel-cell stack, battery and auxiliary components, with configurations aimed primarily at transport applications. Inputs describe component parameters and operating conditions; outputs are simulated dynamic component and system behaviour. Geographic scope is a configured vehicle or facility, while run duration and time step depend on the chosen simulation. The repository provides version 2.0.0 with a software DOI and instructions for OpenModelica 1.20 on Windows. Its source is free under MIT terms. The maintainers say other platforms might work but were not tested during development; earlier library versions require OpenModelica 1.14. That version-specific dependency limits reuse without matching the toolchain. The library can support fuel-cell vehicle or stationary power-system design studies. It is a component model, not a transport-network simulator. The source and installation instructions were inspected, but no Modelica simulation was run. It complements network-scale transport models by representing vehicle fuel-cell dynamics.
inputs: Fuel-cell, battery and auxiliary component configurations
